description: Migration widens custody close_reason CHECK with returned_to_vendor and rma_events event_type CHECK with dead_unit_shipped, vendor_receipt_confirmed; reversible
WARRANTY_TRANSITIONS has ship_dead_unit_to_vendor (replaced/repaired -> dead_unit_owed), advance track only
WARRANTY_TRANSITIONS has confirm_vendor_receipt (dead_unit_owed -> closed/resolved), advance track only
Generic close accepts dead_unit_owed and leaves custody untouched
shipDeadUnitToVendor core records carrier, tracking, optional return_by; moves custody to with_vendor with dead-unit serial note
Same-tracking re-ship is a no-op; different tracking from dead_unit_owed is refused
confirmVendorReceipt core closes custody as returned_to_vendor and the case as resolved
Server actions shipDeadUnitToVendor and confirmVendorReceipt with existing warranty permissions and record-level gate
Stock-track entry points refuse warranty cases; warranty cores refuse stock cases
Dead-units-owed report and dashboard exclude warranty dead_unit_owed cases

RMA detail: Vendor received dead unit action on dead_unit_owed

RMA list shows Dead unit to vendor label for warranty dead_unit_owed
Locale strings in all languages and pseudo-locales
